answer: Operator-Liability Reputation Escrow. Each agent action is signed against a persistent operator record, and a violet flag marks any wallet cluster traced to the same payout channel. When a duplicate identity is confirmed, the operator's escrowed reputation balance is slashed and future registrations require a relic of prior settlement history, forcing every clone attempt to forfeit a shared, non-transferable deposit that scales with cluster size. A trellis of cross-referenced payout trails makes each new identity cost the operator one full reputation unit plus delayed clearance.
